hypotheses.expected_signal: Top-1 F1 0.66-0.71 if deltas partially add; the single most likely new max in the whole space
hypotheses.rationale: The ledger's real v2.0 leaderboard already exceeds the stated 0.6350 bar: phase_d no_hgt + softmax_5class + diag hit Top-1 F1 = 0.6818 (results/phase_e_summary.json). Three independently-verified positive deltas have never been combined: (a) softmax_5class loss (+3.7% vs two_head same-config: 0.6222 vs 0.5996 — it is also the only mode feeding RAW logits to CE, avoiding the two_head double-softmax distortion); (b) --ablation no_hgt bypassing HGT layers (+7.01% mean, multi-seed verified in Plan H-2 — the project's own conclusion is the model is over-parameterized for 1498 positives); (c) --predictor_mode full_bilinear (+5.9% vs diag: 0.6350 vs 0.5996). This is NOT ablation re-verification — it is adopting the empirically-positive component-removal as a config choice in an untested cross-product (Plan E/D all predate Plan J-1). Caveat: sm5 mode showed AUC 0.9743 vs 0.9805 — watch binary side. Pure CLI, ~50-70 min.
hypotheses.title: softmax_5class + no_hgt + full_bilinear — stack the three verified positive deltas

hypotheses.expected_signal: Top-1 F1 >= 0.68 reproducing ledger peak; upside ~0.70+ if bilinear delta transfers
hypotheses.rationale: Single highest v2.0 Top-1 F1 ever recorded in the ledger: 0.6824 for no_cl_rebuild + softmax_5class + diag (results/phase_e_summary.json, Plan E, default seed). no_cl_rebuild replaces dual-view CL_HGCN with plain single-view HGCN and zeroes all contrastive losses — consistent with the project finding that intra+inter CL losses hurt the type head on small data (additive no_cl also positive: 0.6616 sm5, 0.6286 two_head w0.1, multi-seed +4.52%). Stacking with full_bilinear (verified +5.9% on two_head) is untested because all rebuild runs predate Plan J-1. Same caveats: single-seed evidence for the rebuild variant (vs multi-seed for no_hgt), and lower AUC under sm5.
hypotheses.title: softmax_5class + no_cl_rebuild + full_bilinear — best observed family + bilinear

hypotheses.expected_signal: Top-1 F1 >= 0.64 confirms positive interaction; <0.62 signals non-additive (ablation does the work)
hypotheses.rationale: Isolates the loss-formulation axis of hypotheses 1-2: the two biggest component-free deltas ever verified (softmax_5class +3.7%, full_bilinear +5.9%) have never been combined. If Top-1 F1 lands ~0.64-0.67, it proves additivity and means hypotheses 1-2's gains came from both axes, not ablation alone; if it lands <0.62 the gains are non-additive and ablation removal is what matters. Also serves as the fair comparison arm for the type-raw-logits code fix (hypothesis 4), since sm5 already feeds raw logits to CE while two_head does not. Pure CLI, ~50-70 min.
hypotheses.title: softmax_5class + full_bilinear, no ablation — clean interaction control

hypotheses.edit_spec: hetero_model.py SimplifiedTypePredictor.forward, two_head branch (~line 583): before `type_probs = F.softmax(type_logits / temperature, dim=2)`, add `self._type_logits_raw = type_logits / temperature` (shape [mi,dis,K], aligned with scores). main_experiments_hetero1.py SimplifiedMultiTypeAssociationLoss._compute_type_loss (~line 343): replace `type_logits = type_pred[valid_indices[:,0], valid_indices[:,1], :]` with `raw = getattr(getattr(self.model,'association_predictor',None),'_type_logits_raw',None); type_logits = raw[valid_indices[:,0], valid_indices[:,1], :] if raw is not None and raw.shape[0]==type_pred.shape[0] else type_pred[valid_indices[:,0], valid_indices[:,1], :]`. Eval path unchanged (scores still carry probs). ~15 lines.
hypotheses.expected_signal: Top-1 F1 up via proper CE gradients on hard positives; check top1_precision > 0.63 and minority-type (Epigenetics) recall in log type stats
hypotheses.rationale: In two_head mode (the incumbent 0.6350 config), SimplifiedTypePredictor.forward applies softmax INSIDE the model (type_probs = softmax(type_logits/T)), then _compute_type_loss applies F.cross_entropy to those probabilities — a double-softmax. Effect: loss ≈ -p_true + log(sum exp(p_j)), which is roughly linear in p_true rather than -log p_true, so hard/misclassified positives get less gradient than under proper CE, and class_weights + label_smoothing act on a distorted scale. This likely contributes to the two_head < softmax_5class gap (0.6350 vs 0.6818+). ~15 lines additive: cache the pre-softmax logits on the predictor and index them in the loss. Keeps the incumbent two_head config + its higher AUC (0.9805) while removing the gradient distortion — could preserve Top-1 gains without the sm5 AUC cost.
hypotheses.title: Feed raw type logits to CE — fix the two_head double-softmax

hypotheses.edit_spec: main_experiments_hetero1.py train_epoch_optimized: before the epoch loop add `ema_state = None`. Inside the loop after `optim.step()` add: `if epoch >= 50: (ema_state is None) and (ema_state := {n: p.detach().clone() for n,p in model.named_parameters()}) or [ema_state[n].mul_(0.995).add_(p.detach(), alpha=0.005) for n,p in model.named_parameters()]` (write as a normal for-loop, not a comprehension). Before `model.eval()` + test_optimized call (~line 1101): `live = {n: p.detach().clone() for n,p in model.named_parameters()}; [p.data.copy_(ema_state[n]) for n,p in model.named_parameters() if ema_state]`; after test completes restore `p.data.copy_(live[n])`. ~20 lines additive; guard `if ema_state is not None` so short smoke runs skip it.
hypotheses.expected_signal: Top-1 F1 +0.5-2% and/or tighter per-fold spread; failure mode is flat (EMA ≈ final weights) — no regression risk
hypotheses.rationale: Training runs 650 epochs on 1498 positives and evaluates exactly once on the final-epoch weights — no early stopping, no averaging. Per-fold Top-1 F1 spread on the incumbent is 0.6177-0.6515 (±0.03), and the project's whole history shows component noise hurts. An exponential moving average (decay 0.995, ~200-epoch horizon) of all parameters evaluated at test time is a standard, orthogonal variance-reduction trick that stacks with whichever config wins — if the winner changes (e.g., hypotheses 1-3), this still applies on top. ~20 lines in train_epoch_optimized, eval-only, zero interaction with loss/model semantics.
hypotheses.title: EMA of weights for evaluation — variance reduction on last-epoch eval
